pages.text: Yara and Fizz go down the path.
pages.picture: girl and baby dragon walking down a path

pages.text: The path ends at a big, wet bog. Mud! Muck! Fog!
Then the mud starts to fizz. A monster pops up in the bog.
pages.picture: a monster rising out of a bog

pages.text: It is Grub, the Bog Monster! He has six arms and a big wet chin.
"No one gets past my bog!" said Grub.
pages.picture: the mud monster blocking the way

pages.text: Fizz huffs. Puff! But no spark pops out. Fizz is too little.
pages.picture: baby dragon failing to make a spark

pages.text: Yara thinks and thinks. Then she has a plan.
pages.picture: girl thinking with a lightbulb moment
